clauses.scope_note: Section A.1 permits Customer to use Anthropic Services, including to power products and services made available to its Users; this is not a grant of rights in third-party features or other intellectual property.
clauses.condition_explanation: applicable_terms_and_restrictions means the Terms and incorporated policies and service terms, including the restrictions in D.2 and D.4.

clauses.scope_note: Section A.2: Customer may elect, in its sole discretion, to use Third Party Features made available through the Services; the Terms state these features are not Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is limited to third-party features made available to Customer through the Services; it does not establish rights beyond that election.

clauses.scope_note: Section A.3 permits Anthropic to use feedback Customer voluntarily provides regarding the Services, at Anthropic’s own risk and without obligation to Customer.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback_to_anthropic means Customer elects to provide feedback regarding the Services.

clauses.scope_note: Section B prohibits Anthropic from training models on Customer Content from the Services. Customer Content comprises Customer and User Inputs and Service-generated Outputs; this prohibition does not itself restrict Customer’s training use.
clauses.condition_explanation: Customer Content means Inputs submitted to the Services by Customer or its Users and Outputs generated by the Services in response to Inputs.

obligation_items.content: Do not train models on Customer Content from the Services.
obligation_items.object: Customer Content from the Services, including Inputs and Outputs

clauses.scope_note: Section B recognizes Customer’s retained rights in Inputs and ownership of Outputs, and assigns Anthropic’s right, title, and interest, if any, in Outputs to Customer subject to Customer’s compliance. This records the conditional assignment and does not infer additional rights or permissions from the ownership statements.
clauses.condition_explanation: Customer Content consists of Inputs and Outputs as defined in Section B; comply_with_terms is the stated condition on the assignment.

clauses.scope_note: Section C requires data submitted through the Services to be processed in accordance with the incorporated Anthropic Data Processing Addendum. The DPA’s specific requirements are not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: data_submitted_through_services identifies the scope of the processing statement; process_in_accordance_with_incorporated_dpa depends on the incorporated DPA, whose terms are unavailable here.

obligation_items.content: Process data submitted through the Services in accordance with the Anthropic Data Processing Addendum.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever such data is processed through the Services.

clauses.actor_role: Customer and Anthropic, each for its own stated activity
clauses.scope_note: Section D.1 imposes compliance with applicable laws on Anthropic for provision and on Customer for use of the Services, expressly including applicable data privacy laws.
clauses.condition_explanation: The applicable-law duty is assigned separately: Anthropic for provision; Customer for use. The clause does not specify additional laws beyond those applicable to the respective activity.

obligation_items.content: Comply with laws applicable to Customer’s use of the Services, including applicable data privacy laws.
Comply with laws applicable to Anthropic’s provision of the Services, including applicable data privacy laws.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.2 limits Customer’s and Users’ use to compliance with the Terms and incorporated Usage Policy, Supported Regions Policy, and Service Specific Terms. Those incorporated documents are not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: The referenced policies and service terms are incorporated by reference; their specific requirements cannot be determined from this excerpt.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.2 requires Customer to cooperate with Anthropic’s reasonable requests for information supporting Usage Policy compliance, including identity and use verification.
clauses.condition_explanation: The duty is triggered by a reasonable request for information from Anthropic to support Usage Policy compliance.

obligation_items.content: Cooperate with Anthropic’s reasonable requests for information to support Usage Policy compliance, including verification of Customer’s identity and Service use.
obligation_items.object: Information about Customer’s identity and use of the Services
obligation_items.trigger: When Anthropic makes a reasonable request for information to support Usage Policy compliance.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.3 makes evaluation Customer’s responsibility before using or sharing Outputs; it expressly includes considering whether human review is appropriate.
clauses.condition_explanation: The evaluation must occur before the relevant use or sharing. The clause does not prescribe a particular evaluation method or require human review in every case.

obligation_items.content: Evaluate whether Outputs are appropriate for Customer’s use case, including whether human review is appropriate, before using or sharing them.
obligation_items.trigger: Before Customer uses or shares an Output.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.3 requires Customer to notify its Users not to rely on factual assertions in Outputs without independently checking accuracy, because they may be false, incomplete, misleading, or not reflect recent information.
clauses.condition_explanation: The required notice concerns factual assertions in Outputs and the need for independent accuracy checking; the clause does not require Customer to label all Outputs as Anthropic’s views.

obligation_items.content: Notify Users that factual assertions in Outputs should not be relied upon without independently checking their accuracy and may be false, incomplete, misleading, or not reflect recent information.
obligation_items.object: Notice to Customer’s Users about factual assertions in Outputs
obligation_items.trigger: When Customer has Users to whom it makes the Services available.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.4(a) prohibits accessing the Services to build a competing product or service, including training competing AI models or reselling the Services, except where Anthropic expressly approves.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to access for competitive development; the express-approval exception applies to the listed conduct, including resale.

obligation_items.content: Do not access the Services to build a product or service competing with Anthropic’s Services, including to train a competing AI model or resell the Services, unless Anthropic expressly approves.
obligation_items.trigger: When accessing the Services for competitive product or service development, model training, or resale; exception if Anthropic expressly approves.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.4(b) prohibits Customer from reverse engineering or duplicating the Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: No exception is stated in this section.

obligation_items.content: Do not reverse engineer or duplicate the Services.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer acts with respect to the Services.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.4(c) prohibits Customer from supporting a third party’s attempt at the conduct restricted by D.4(a) or D.4(b).
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is a third party’s attempt to engage in competitive access or development, reverse engineering, or duplication described in D.4(a)–(b).

obligation_items.content: Do not support a third party’s attempt to engage in conduct restricted by Section D.4(a) or D.4(b).
obligation_items.trigger: When a third party attempts conduct restricted by Section D.4(a) or D.4(b).

clauses.scope_note: Section D.5 assigns Customer responsibility for all activity under its account; it does not itself state that Customer must prevent every such activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is activity under the account through which Customer accesses the Services.

clauses.scope_note: Section D.5 requires prompt notice to Anthropic if Customer believes its access account has been compromised or is subject to a denial-of-service or similar malicious attack that may negatively impact the Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger requires Customer’s belief of compromise or the specified malicious attack; the attack must be one that may negatively impact the Services.

obligation_items.content: Promptly notify Anthropic of the believed account compromise or qualifying denial-of-service or similar malicious attack.
obligation_items.object: Customer’s Service account and the reported attack
obligation_items.trigger: When Customer believes its account is compromised, or is subject to a denial-of-service or similar malicious attack that may negatively impact the Services.

clauses.scope_note: Section E.2 limits a Recipient’s use of the Discloser’s Confidential Information to exercising rights and performing obligations under the Terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: Confidential Information is as identified or reasonably understood as confidential under E.1; E.3 exclusions apply, but do not alter this rule for information that remains Confidential Information.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the Discloser’s Confidential Information except to exercise rights or perform obligations under the Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Recipient uses information that qualifies as the Discloser’s Confidential Information under E.1, subject to E.3 exclusions.

clauses.scope_note: Section E.2 permits sharing only with the Recipient’s employees, agents, and advisors who meet all stated conditions. Section E.3 separately permits legally required disclosure subject to its notice and cooperation conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The ordinary sharing path requires all three stated recipient conditions. The legally required disclosure path is an exception addressed separately in clause legally_required_confidential_disclosure.

clauses.scope_note: Section E.3 permits disclosure of the Discloser’s Confidential Information to the extent required by law or court or administrative order; notice is excepted where expressly prohibited.
clauses.condition_explanation: The disclosure must be required by law or court or administrative order. Prompt notice and full cooperation are required unless notice is expressly prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Limit disclosure of Confidential Information to the extent required by law or court or administrative order.
obligation_items.trigger: When disclosure is required by law or court or administrative order.

obligation_items.content: Promptly notify the Discloser of the required disclosure and fully cooperate with efforts to prevent or narrow its scope, unless notice is expressly prohibited.
obligation_items.object: Notice and cooperation concerning required disclosure of Confidential Information
obligation_items.trigger: When disclosure is legally required and notification is not expressly prohibited.

clauses.scope_note: Section E.4 requires destruction promptly upon request, with exceptions for retention to comply with law and copies in automated backup systems; backup copies remain subject to confidentiality obligations while maintained.
clauses.condition_explanation: The destruction duty is triggered by the Discloser’s request. The excerpt’s activity vocabulary has no destruction activity, so this clause records the operative duty under Use without treating Use as a literal destruction action.

obligation_items.content: Promptly destroy the Discloser’s Confidential Information upon request, except information retained to comply with law and copies in automated backup systems; backup copies must remain subject to confidentiality obligations while maintained.
obligation_items.trigger: Upon the Discloser’s request, except for legally required retention and automated backup copies, which remain subject to confidentiality obligations while maintained.

clauses.scope_note: Section F denies rights by implication or otherwise except as expressly stated in the Terms. This records the boundary on implied grants, not a general prohibition on otherwise authorized use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The boundary applies to rights in the other party’s content or intellectual property that are not expressly granted by the Terms.

obligation_items.content: Do not claim rights in the other party’s content or intellectual property by implication or otherwise, except rights expressly stated in the Terms.
obligation_items.object: The other party’s content or intellectual property
obligation_items.trigger: When asserting a right not expressly stated in the Terms.

clauses.scope_note: Section G permits Anthropic to use Customer’s name and logo publicly to identify Customer as a Services customer, subject to Customer’s ability to opt out via the request form.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission applies unless Customer opts out via the specified request form.

clauses.scope_note: Section G requires Customer to consider in good faith Anthropic’s requests for an executive quote about motivation for using the Services for public use, and for participation in public co-marketing. It does not require Customer to provide a quote or participate.
clauses.condition_explanation: The duty is to consider each applicable request in good faith, not to accept it.

obligation_items.content: Consider in good faith Anthropic’s request for a Customer executive quote for public use or participation in a public co-marketing activity.
obligation_items.object: Anthropic’s request for a quote or public co-marketing participation
obligation_items.trigger: When Anthropic makes either stated request.

coverage_notes: The incorporated Usage Policy, Supported Regions Policy, Service Specific Terms, and Anthropic Data Processing Addendum are not supplied, so their detailed conditions cannot be extracted.

Section B ownership and assignment statements are represented only as the stated conditional assignment and retained-rights boundary; they do not establish an unrestricted permission to use every Input or Output.
Confidentiality exclusions in E.3 apply to information meeting the stated exclusions; the excerpt does not supply further procedural details beyond those modeled.
No termination or cure provisions are present in these target paragraphs.
